title: Coefficient Dynamics and Consecutive Toeplitz Minors for the de Bruijn–Newman Famil
summary: Abstract We give a normalization-consistent coefficient formulation of the de Bruijn–Newman heat flow attached to the Riemann ξ-function. For the classical kernel Φ and the family Ht(z) = Z ∞ 0 e tu2 Φ(u) cos(zu) du, Ft(w) = Ht(i √ w) = X n≥0 qn(t)w n , we prove the exact evolution laws ∂tFt = 2F ′ t + 4wF′′ t , q(m) n (t) = (2n + 2m)! (2n)! qn+m(t). The coefficients have positive integral representations and the transformed entire function has order at most 1/2.
